resources.string: Pause Ultra DNS while a VPN is connected
When a VPN handles Waterfox’s network connection, use system/VPN DNS instead of Ultra DNS. Ultra DNS resumes automatically after the VPN disconnects.
Ultra DNS is paused: a VPN is handling Waterfox’s connection. System/VPN DNS is used instead. Ultra DNS will resume automatically after the VPN disconnects.
A VPN is handling Waterfox’s connection, but automatic pausing is off. Ultra DNS remains enabled.
Waterfox cannot detect VPNs on your router. Switching DNS is not instantaneous and may not affect requests already in progress. System/VPN DNS is not necessarily encrypted.
